atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Defines design tokens as CSS variables, including `@theme inline` so utilities read the variables at render time.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind. Inlines utility classes into a rule.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Defines a custom utility class.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Defines a custom variant, for example `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Applies a variant to the declarations in its block.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Adds a source path for class detection.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Loads a plugin from CSS.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind. Points at a JavaScript config file.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Imports theme variables, custom utilities, and variants without emitting the imported CSS.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3. Injects base, components, or utilities.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3. Media query for a named breakpoint.

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3. Generates responsive variants of the rules in its block.

atDirectives.name: @variants
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3. Generates the listed variants of the rules in its block.
